title: Shift Register
description: Interactive p5.js simulation of a 74HC594 shift register demonstrating serial-to-parallel data conversion with clock and latch control signals.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Shift Register
Digital Electronics
Serial to Parallel
74HC594
Microcontroller I/O
learningObjectives: Trace how each clock pulse shifts every bit one position and loads the new data bit into position 0 of the 74HC594's 8-bit shift register
Distinguish the internal shift register from the output register, and explain why the latch signal is required to update the output pins
Predict the register contents after a given sequence of data and clock inputs, such as loading the pattern 10101010
Explain how serial-to-parallel conversion lets a microcontroller drive eight outputs using only data, clock, and latch pins
Calculate how many clock pulses are required to completely load an 8-bit pattern into the register
